usedFor: Hubstaff tracks time, and “Create a Project”, “Create a Client” and “Create a To-Do” set up the work to track.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a To-Do” in Hubstaff
bestTemplate.why: It creates a task in a selected project and assigns it to a team member.

watchOut: “Create a To-Do” needs a selected Hubstaff project and a team member to assign it to.
